ia_dds.title: Iowa DOT Data Driven Safety Guidance

hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.page: sheet 'Reference Lists' D7:D11 (Crash Costs), C2 (Year of Crash Cost Data 2018)
rules: K and A priced the same (Iowa's combined fatal and serious injury cost), one cost per level for every location type
Iowa's C cost is 'Possible/Unknown Injury'; CrashIQ leaves U unpriced (shared rule) and counts it
the worksheet escalates these at 4% a year (sheet 'Benefit Cost Worksheet' D6); CrashIQ prints the 2018 values unescalated

statewide_rates.missing: Iowa DOT's statewide crash averages are a web page (Data Driven Safety Guidance §4.1.4, printed p. 21 (PDF p. 25), link www.iowadot.gov/crashanalysis/comparablesprofilesmain.htm, HTTP 404 on 2026-11-08), and CrashIQ has no Iowa traffic counts

screening.state_method: Iowa DOT's SPF-based Potential for Crash Reduction (PCR) tool (Iowa HSIP 2025 report; not read into CrashIQ)

min_years.page: §2.2.1, printed p. 6 (PDF p. 10): 'the Iowa DOT recommends the analysis use the most recent five years… a minimum of three years'

spf_calibration.missing: Data Driven Safety Guidance Tables 3-1 and 3-2 (printed p. 13, PDF p. 17) publish Iowa freeway and rural two-lane calibration factors; not loaded (no SPF engine)
